nodes.label: BENCHMARKS.md
nodes.rationale: Results here back any speed claim made in the app or docs, and set the v1 speed target.

nodes.label: Benchmark Matrix (sizes x networks x directions)
Phase 1 Proof-of-Concept Benchmarks
nodes.rationale: Release builds only; median of 3 fresh uninterrupted runs; resumed runs excluded from MB/s.

nodes.label: Phase 7 Benchmarks (buffer sizes, network modes, LocalSend)
One-time Preparation (Trust + Auto-accept)
nodes.rationale: Without auto-accept every benchmark run waits for a tap.

nodes.label: Network Setup Labels (Router 2.4/5 GHz, Android hotspot, iPhone hotspot)
Step 0: Measure This Phone (per-phone limits)
nodes.rationale: Isolates sha256, TLS loopback and fsync write costs without the radio so the ceiling of a transfer can be identified (step within 1.5x of transfer MB/s is the ceiling).

nodes.label: Step A: Choose the Buffer Size (256 KB / 1 MB / 4 MB)
nodes.rationale: Winner rule: median, sizes >= 100 MB, within 5% of best on every network and direction, ties go to 1 MB; default changes only in a separate commit with justifying numbers.

nodes.label: Fair LocalSend Comparison Protocol
nodes.rationale: Alternate apps run by run so heat and battery affect both; both use Android Settings tethering because LocalSend cannot use CrossDrop's in-app hotspot; LocalSend timed from receiver screen recording.

nodes.label: Parallel Streams (not built, D-059)
nodes.rationale: Proposed only if CrossDrop is more than ~25% below iperf3 while neither phone's CPU is near one core.

nodes.label: H1: Auth Commitment Covers Both Fingerprints (Protocol v2, D-061)
nodes.rationale: Prevents a man in the middle from choosing a certificate that makes both pairing codes match; version 1 refused.

nodes.label: H2: Declared Size Caps (1 TiB file, 4 TiB offer)
nodes.rationale: Stops sizes from wrapping the 64-bit total and slipping past the free-space check.

nodes.label: H4: iPhone Share vs Launch Cleanup
M6: iPhone Server Health Check and Restart After Lock
M4: Pause Kept Until Upload Sees It
M5/L4: Cancel While Connecting or Checking Address
L1: Exclusive File Creation to Claim Save Name
L5: Discard Old Resumable Send Properly
L7: Network Binding Changes Applied One at a Time
L8: Strip Bidi/Zero-width Chars from Names
nodes.rationale: photo<RLO>gpj.exe displayed as photoexe.jpg; receiver sanitizes on arrival so every screen shows the saved name.

nodes.label: Receiver 8 MB Socket Read-ahead (D-064)
nodes.rationale: Writing, hashing and checkpoints no longer stall the sender.

nodes.label: Sender Reads Next 1 MB While Sending
Android Descriptor I/O Native Buffer Reuse
Measure This Phone (D-066)
nodes.rationale: Each cost is known before the next speed change; larger speed items wait for the numbers.

nodes.label: Android Network Binding (D-056)
nodes.rationale: On Wi-Fi without internet, traffic stays on Wi-Fi instead of mobile data.

nodes.label: Onboarding (three pages)
nodes.rationale: Receiving, and so the iOS Local Network prompt, starts only after onboarding.

nodes.label: Receiving Runs Whenever App Is Open (D-046)
Media Picking (photo_manager gallery, SAF, document picker)
Format Handling (originals, HEIC to JPEG, D-042)
Share from Other Apps (iOS Share Extension, Android SEND)
Pairing and Trust (TLS 1.3 pinning, signed challenge)
Resume with Retry Backoff and 4 MB Checkpoints
Keep-alive (wakelock, foreground service, iOS background task)
Receiver Keeps Hash Across Drops (D-021)
nodes.rationale: Resuming a large file never re-reads what was sent.
